Not listed in the official requirements. Do not put a photo on your resume.
Only if your transcript does not show the degree conferred and its date; then submit a diploma or similar document if you have one.
A transcript for each institution attended for one academic year or longer. Unofficial is accepted; non-English needs an official English translation.
One-page resume on US Letter paper, reverse-chronological, with no photo or hyperlinks.
Two letters in English, due by the deadline. No family; friends generally do not qualify. You may not write or edit your own letter. Separate from your graduate programme's letters.
One essay (550 words) plus three short answers (250, 250 and 150 words). Check the current prompts on the KHS site.
Only if your Stanford graduate programme requires them (e.g. GRE, GMAT). KHS sets no minimum; the programme does. Submit by the later of the programme or KHS deadline.
Only if your Stanford graduate programme requires it (TOEFL accepted by all programmes, IELTS by most). Check your programme's minimum and score validity.
Only if invited (about 500 applicants, rolling in January). Then it is required: up to 2 minutes, face visible, recorded in the online application, topic is teaching something to your cohort.
